name: GUNTHER
source:
With metal running through his veins, GUNTHER enjoys watching and occasionally partaking chaotic situations, although he's well-meaning most of the time. He harbors a confused feeling of rivalry towards Yu, but is mostly concerned with his traveling metal band Ardent Scenery, which he plays lead guitar for.

[From [url=http://exogenesisvn.com/characters/]the official website[/url]]
